description: Verify a dependency against trusted sources. Checks if the source is in the trusted registry and validates the integrity hash if provided.

dependency_id.description: UUID of the dependency — the `id` returned by tork_supply_chain_register (optional; takes precedence over agent_id + dependency_name lookup)

dependency_name.description: Name of the dependency to verify

dependency_type.description: Type of dependency (optional, for more specific verification)

expected_hash.description: Expected integrity hash to verify against (optional)

name: tork_supply_chain_verify
